item.title: Greece’s Military Strength: One of Europe’s Most Powerful Armed Forces
item.description: Greece maintains one of Europe’s most heavily equipped militaries on a per-capita basis, spending over 3% of GDP on defence. With 419,050 personnel, 230 fighter aircraft, 1,385 main battle tanks and a modernizing navy, Greece plays a key role in strengthening NATO’s southeastern flank and security in the Eastern Mediterranean.
